Messages.Author: Rogar
Messages.Body:
Blood Weakens is in play. Henry Taylor is blocked and enters combat. He
plays a card requiring a discipline, say Earth Meld, which he doesn't
replace due to Blood Weakens. At the end of the action, can he first use
his ability to put Earth Meld back on top of my library, and then draw
the Earth Meld to replace the Earth Meld as written on Blood Weakens?
And what if Henry Taylor was blocking in stead of acting?

Rogar

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On July 21, 2005, LSJ wrote:
> Rogar wrote:
>
>> Blood Weakens is in play. Henry Taylor is blocked and enters combat. He
>> plays a card requiring a discipline, say Earth Meld, which he doesn't
>> replace due to Blood Weakens. At the end of the action, can he first use
>> his ability to put Earth Meld back on top of my library, and then draw
>> the Earth Meld to replace the Earth Meld as written on Blood Weakens?
>
> Sure.

REVERSAL: His controller would draw up immediately when the "do not replace
until" ran out, which is before she gets the chance to use Henry's ability.

>> And what if Henry Taylor was blocking in stead of acting?
>
> No difference.

Still no difference: draw the replacement card first.
